functions.name: InvoiceActions
params:
{
  invoiceId,
  invoiceRef,
  status,
  sentAt,
  canWrite,
  canDelete,
}

callGraph.callee:
db
    .select({ invoice: invoices, client: userTable, quote: { id: quotes.id, ref: quotes.ref } })
    .from(invoices)
    .innerJoin(userTable, eq(userTable.id, invoices.userId))
    .leftJoin(quotes, eq(quotes.id, invoices.quoteId))
    .where(eq(invoices.id, id))
    .limit

db
    .select({ invoice: invoices, client: userTable, quote: { id: quotes.id, ref: quotes.ref } })
    .from(invoices)
    .innerJoin(userTable, eq(userTable.id, invoices.userId))
    .leftJoin(quotes, eq(quotes.id, invoices.quoteId))
    .where

db
    .select({ invoice: invoices, client: userTable, quote: { id: quotes.id, ref: quotes.ref } })
    .from(invoices)
    .innerJoin(userTable, eq(userTable.id, invoices.userId))
    .leftJoin

db
    .select({ invoice: invoices, client: userTable, quote: { id: quotes.id, ref: quotes.ref } })
    .from(invoices)
    .innerJoin

db
    .select({ invoice: invoices, client: userTable, quote: { id: quotes.id, ref: quotes.ref } })
    .from

db
      .update(invoices)
      .set({
        title: parsed.data.title,
        note: parsed.data.note ?? null,
        dueAt: parsed.data.dueAt ?? null,
        currency: parsed.data.currency,
        lines,
        amountCents,
        overrides: ov.overrides,
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      })
      .where

db
      .update(invoices)
      .set({ status: "envoyee", issuedAt: invoice.issuedAt ?? new Date(), updatedAt: new Date() })
      .where
